integrity: Proved using a matrix-tree identity, exact bivariate enumeration, factorial domination and analytic differentiation. Finite checks corroborate the proof, without replacing it. No independent external scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a,b growing with b/a tending to a finite positive constant. No rate, arbitrary-ratio extension, or non-complete split-graph generalization is established; historical priority is qualified by incomplete access to one older source.
title: Independent Poisson omission counts in uniform subtrees of complete split graphs
